t: Internal drywall bead for installation and finishing of drywall or gypsum board. Use functionally to protect and reinforce the edges of drywall panels that can be prone to chipping and damage. Use aesthetically to provide edge definition by creating straight and clean edges along interior corners and transitions. Helps guide and align drywall panels. Reduces the need for maintenance and repairs.
b: Reduces the Need for Maintenance & Repairs
